description: This file contains the PHP class 'Permission' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Error' namespace. It is a controller extending the base controller class, handling error permission pages in the OpenCart admin interface. The class primarily defines an 'index' method responsible for setting up the page's language, title, breadcrumbs, and loading the header, footer, and view components for rendering the permission error page.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling 'permission' error pages in the admin section, extending the core controller and setting up the error view with appropriate language, breadcrumbs, and template loading.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up the language, title, breadcrumbs, and loads header, column, footer, and view components to render the permission error page.
